cookie.intro: Paste cookies from your browser to download members-only content, channel memberships, or content behind a login. Cookies are used for this download only — they are not stored.
cookie.guideTitle: How to get cookies from your browser
cookie.chrome1: Install the <m>Get cookies.txt LOCALLY</m> extension from the Chrome Web Store
cookie.chrome2: Go to the site you want to download from (YouTube, Instagram…) and sign in
cookie.chrome3: Click the extension icon → choose Export as Netscape
cookie.chrome4: Copy the entire contents of the <m>.txt</m> file → paste it into the box below
cookie.firefox2: Sign in to the site, open the add-on → Export cookies in Netscape format
cookie.firefox3: Paste the contents into the box below
cookie.warning: ⚠️ Cookies contain your sign-in details — only use them on a trusted device. Do not share your cookies with anyone.
cookie.placeholder:
# Netscape HTTP Cookie File
.youtube.com	TRUE	/	TRUE	...

or paste Raw: SID=abc123; HSID=def456
or JSON array: [{"name":"SID","value":"abc123",...}]
cookie.willUse: Cookies will be used for this download
cookie.supported: Supported: Netscape (.txt from an extension), JSON array, or a raw cookie string
